scientific_integrity: Analytical proof presented; finite exact-rational and high-precision checks supplement rather than certify the universal theorem. Historical bibliography assessed from available material only.
scientific_limitations: Exact result only for the boundary evaluation of equal-weight real degree-two least-squares fits on a uniform closed-interval grid. No full operator norm for all output points, other polynomial degrees or irregular nodes is claimed. Historical priority is uncertain because some relevant older full texts were unavailable.
title: Arithmetic second-order boundary amplification in discrete quadratic least squares
